name: queen-of-hearts-fashion
image_vibe: Romantic polished crimson couture with sculptural heart-shaped chiffon and clean card graphics
image_purpose: Create a high-concept fashion campaign visual with a Queen of Hearts playing-card theme.

prompt.project_info: A 4:5 portrait-oriented high-concept fashion studio portrait using the required approved-adult identity reference and a sculptural red heart-shaped fabric backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: The adult person from the required approved-adult identity reference; preserve the original face, facial likeness, cheeks, nose, eyes, jawline, and natural facial structure without idealization. Give the subject long wavy brunette hair and a contained elegant pose, body angled away while twisting to look back over the left shoulder. The subject wears a deep crimson red strapless gown and matching matte red opera-length gloves.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait framing with arms crossed over the chest and the subject looking directly into the lens. Massive layers of sheer semi-translucent red chiffon or organza billow behind the subject into a perfect voluminous heart shape, with deep ruby shadows and bright cherry highlights. Use a clean white seamless backdrop and place a large red serif 'Q' directly above a red heart suit symbol in the top-left corner.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused high-key studio lighting with even illumination and soft shadows, emphasizing the three-dimensional folds and translucency of the heart-shaped fabric, polished romantic editorial atmosphere, and strong crimson-on-white contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio, medium shot, high-resolution photorealistic fashion photography, realistic chiffon/organza folds, fabric opacity variation, glove and gown texture, subtle film grain, clean typography rendering, no extra text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-concept 4:5 portrait-oriented fashion studio image using the required approved-adult identity reference. Preserve the original adult person's face, facial likeness, cheeks, nose, eyes, jawline, and natural facial structure without idealization. Give the subject long wavy brunette hair and pose them in a medium shot with the body angled away, twisting to look back over the left shoulder directly at the lens, arms crossed elegantly over the chest. Dress the subject in a deep crimson red strapless gown and matching matte red opera-length gloves. Behind the subject, sculpt massive layers of sheer semi-translucent red chiffon or organza into a perfect voluminous heart shape, with realistic folds, textures, and opacity shifting from deep ruby shadows to bright cherry highlights. Use a clean solid white seamless backdrop and place a large red serif capital 'Q' directly above a red heart suit symbol in the top-left corner, mimicking a playing-card index. Use soft diffused high-key studio lighting, soft shadows, polished romantic editorial color, subtle film grain, accurate fabric translucency, high-resolution realism, and no extra text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identity drift, face idealization, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed fabric heart, unreadable card symbols, extra text, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark

assets.name: approved adult identity reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult subject's original facial likeness and structure; do not alter, beautify, or replace identity.

assets.name: Queen of Hearts card-index graphic
assets.usage: Use optional guidance for the red serif Q above red heart symbol in the top-left; preserve only the specified graphic and no other text.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the approved adult identity reference. Keep the face, crimson gown, red gloves, over-the-shoulder pose, heart-shaped chiffon sculpture, white backdrop, and top-left Q/heart graphic. The fabric arrangement may vary while preserving the heart silhouette.
